newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly down in after-hours trade on Friday on the view that prices in producing countries had bottomed out, fuelling short-covering by private investors ahead of the close, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.5 yen per kg lower to 0.2 yen up from the day's close. Benchmark July was up 0.2 yen at 145.4 yen.
Volume was thin with 2,500 lots traded.

Prices drifted within narrow ranges for most of the day. "The market was basically directionless and is unlikely to break out of its recent range-trading anytime soon," one trader said. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk +81-3-3432-7431
